name: What results can an optometry practice expect from effective AEO?

mainEntity.name: What results can an optometry practice expect from effective AEO?

acceptedAnswer.text: Effective AEO can lead to several positive outcomes for an optometry practice. You can expect increased visibility in search engine results pages, particularly in featured snippets and direct answers, which can enhance your practice's authority and credibility. This often translates to higher-quality organic traffic, as users are finding direct answers from your site. Over time, this improved visibility and authority can contribute to more patient inquiries, appointment bookings, and a stronger online presence within your local community.
acceptedAnswer.description: Effective AEO can increase visibility in direct answers and featured snippets, leading to higher-quality organic traffic, enhanced authority, and more patient inquiries.
